name: Zonot Five
description: An upworlder sinkhole where the ghost's ship is brought.

description_citations.text: "Medge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The students bring the ship to the zonot, where the ghost reveals his sinister form; Miko opens the chest, a fight follows, and Chessa tricks a krasis into swallowing the medallion, destroying the ghost.
timeline.quote: led the ghost to his demise by tricking a krasis into swallowing it

timeline.summary: The group presents the recovered Simic artifacts, including the lost keyrune of Momir Vig, to the zonot's guardians and tours a museum.
timeline.quote: the lost keyrune of Momir Vig

timeline.summary: Miko accidentally causes a cytoplast to fall on Medge, starting her mutation; the class is imprisoned and then released through Zegana's intervention.

citation.text: "Medge", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Medge advocates for her students, who are allowed to pursue their dreams; Kaszira gets to study in the zonots and Medge reconciles with Ptero to train protectors together.
